belay.P2: Belay on the ledge where two large, twisted trees stand, above the wide crack.
belay.P2.5: The stance is a small bowl with a tall tree as the anchor, reached above the right side of the twisted trees.
belay.P3: Belay on a small ledge at the top of the pitch.

belay.2: The anchor is on a ledge out to the left, above the 4-inch cracks of the Western Dihedral.
belay.3: Belay at the anchor reached after the finger traverse, the dirty hump and the two bolts on the smear.
belay.4: The anchor is reached by following a single bolt off to the right at the top of the long slab ramble.
belay.5: A sling threaded around a rock pinch at the summit serves as the belay.
